description: This file defines the class 'Document' in the namespace 'Opencart\System\Library'. The class 'Document' manages metadata and resource links such as title, description, keywords, links, styles, and scripts for system documentation or API generation purposes. It provides methods to set and retrieve these properties and to add external link, style, and script references.

classes.name: Document
classes.description: A class that encapsulates metadata and resource management for system documentation or API pages.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the document.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Retrieves the title of the document.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description metadata for the document.

methods.name: setKeywords
methods.description: Sets the keywords metadata for the document.

methods.name: addLink
methods.description: Adds an external link reference with rel attribute.

methods.name: addStyle
methods.description: Adds a stylesheet link with optional rel and media attributes.

methods.name: addScript
methods.description: Adds a JavaScript resource either to the header or footer.

methods.name: getScripts
methods.description: Retrieves scripts added to a specific position (header or footer).
